_comment: F2L (First Two Layers) algorithms. All 41 cases. Assumes white cross is solved on U face. Each pair is described by the corner and edge positions. Standard orientation: F2L slot is Front-Right. Apply U moves to bring pieces above the correct slot before executing.

F2L_1._comment: Corner and edge both in top layer, correctly oriented, corner above slot

F2L_2._comment: Corner and edge both in top layer, edge needs pairing first

F2L_3._comment: Corner in top layer white facing up, edge in top layer

F2L_4._comment: Corner in top layer white facing front, edge paired

F2L_5._comment: Corner in top layer white facing right, edge paired

F2L_6._comment: Corner in U layer white up, edge already in slot correct

F2L_7._comment: Corner in U layer white up, edge in slot flipped

F2L_8._comment: Corner in U layer white front, edge in slot correct

F2L_9._comment: Corner in U layer white front, edge in slot flipped

F2L_10._comment: Corner in U layer white right, edge in slot correct

F2L_11._comment: Corner in U layer white right, edge in slot flipped

F2L_12._comment: Corner in slot correct, edge in U layer needs inserting

F2L_13._comment: Corner in slot flipped, edge in U layer same column

F2L_14._comment: Corner in slot white front, edge in U layer

F2L_15._comment: Corner in slot white right, edge in U layer wrong position

F2L_16._comment: Corner in slot white down, edge in U layer above slot

F2L_17._comment: Corner in slot white down, edge in U layer beside slot

F2L_18._comment: Corner white up, edge pointing to right

F2L_19._comment: Corner white up, edge pointing to front

F2L_20._comment: Corner white front, edge correct side

F2L_21._comment: Corner white front, edge opposite side

F2L_22._comment: Corner white front, edge facing up

F2L_24._comment: Corner white right, edge correct side

F2L_25._comment: Corner white right, edge opposite side

F2L_26._comment: Corner white right, edge facing up

F2L_28._comment: Both pieces in slot but corner wrong orientation, edge correct

F2L_29._comment: Both in slot, corner correct, edge flipped

F2L_32._comment: Corner bottom, edge top - corner white down facing front

F2L_33._comment: Corner bottom, edge top - corner white down facing right

F2L_34._comment: Corner bottom, edge top - edge at UF pointing up

F2L_35._comment: Corner bottom, edge top - edge at UR pointing up

F2L_36._comment: Pair formed in U layer facing wrong direction

F2L_37._comment: Pair formed, needs rotating before insert

F2L_38._comment: Edge in bottom layer wrong slot - requires extraction

F2L_39._comment: Pair already formed in U, insert directly right

F2L_40._comment: Pair already formed in U, insert directly left

F2L_41._comment: Empty slot - corner and edge both in other slots (extract first)
